name: – Tomáš Kubín – Article 12, after § 4 – Am 96
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on the structure and rates of excise duty applied to tobacco and tobacco related products (recast)
part_text: 4a. The adjustment of minimum Union rates pursuant to this Article shall not be subject to any upper limit. Any cap on the periodic adjustment would risk reproducing the structural erosion of minimum rates that characterised the period of application of Directive 2011/64/EU, contrary to the public health and internal market objectives of this Directive.
